'''Devaron''' was the home world of the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]]. It was located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], near the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]]. It was a planet of low mountains and deep valleys linked by thousands of rivers. The planet had strict capital punishment and a matriarchal government.

==History==
Developing [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] technology as early as [[30,000 BBY]], the Devaronian culture had developed quickly from hunter-gatherers to an industrial power in a short amount of time. The species developed a divide in gender roles during their tribal stage when males had to travel several days from settlements to hunt for prey while the females maintained the safety and organization of the camp. While the matriarchal government developed and funded space technology, it was the wanderlust of the males which drove the species to the stars and beyond. Exploring the region of space around Devaron, Devaronian explorers made contact with other hyperspace [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] and helped blaze the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]].<ref name="NoP" /> One of the earliest planetary governments to join the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], sometime between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]], Devaron was one of the farthest points in known space, forming a border with [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] for millennia.<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:Devaronians.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A male and female Devaronian.]]
While the government of Devaron was a representative government that matured to a point where the strict divisions between gender roles was blurred, Devaronian females were historically the most prestigious government officials.<ref name="NoP" /> To this end, the government was largely matriarchal, as males sought out roles that better suited their primal wanderlust that drove them into the jungles or the stars.

During the [[Jedi Civil War]], the planet was the site of a [[Battle of Devaron (Jedi Civil War)|battle]] won by the Republic.<ref name="TEA" /> 

Devaron was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] jointly by [[Elsah'sai'Moro]] and [[Vien'sai'Malloc]] during the final days of the ancient democracy. However, in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Elsah was assassinated by [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] who had been hired by Vien, who was herself arrested for both her assassination attempt and her secret sponsoring of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] base in the [[Blue Mountains]].<ref>''[[Jedi: Aayla Secura]]''</ref>

In that same year, [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|attacked]] a Republic outpost on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in order to capture [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]], who was the keeper of the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]], which contained a list of Force-sensitive children in the Galaxy. Later, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] arrived in the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] in order to reclaim the holocron. During the battle, the ''Resolute'' later engaged Bane's [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]]. Bane managed to escape, but the bounty hunter fleet was destroyed.<ref name="CoD">{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}}</ref>

[[File:Jungle_of_Devaron.png|thumb|left|250px|A jungle on Devaron.]]
Later in the war, the [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Temple of Eedit]] on Devaron was [[Devaron massacre/Legends|attacked]] by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces. This battle was the first appearance of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] new [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|apprentice]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and where [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Knox/Legends|Knox]] died. Under President [[Aven'sai'Ulrahk]], the planet continued to support the Republic throughout the rest of the war before falling under the sway of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following the war's end. Around [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]], Devaron was the site of an [[Battle of Montellian Serat|uprising]] against the Empire, which was put down by the Imperial-aligned [[Devaronian Army]], led by [[Kardue'sai'Malloc/Legends|Kardue'sai'Malloc]], whom was thus called the "Butcher of Montellian Serat". To escape persecution, the Butcher fled to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and changed his name to Labria. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] captured Labria and took him to Devaron, where the Butcher was executed.

The planet was denied membership in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] due to its violent capital punishment. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the planetary government of Devaron attempted to appease the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] by offering [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Hivrekh'wao'Cheklev]], who was able to escape. Some female Devaronians wished to join the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and proposed a termination to feeding criminals to the [[quarra]]. However, they met with strong resistance from traditionalists.

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'' erroneously states that Devaron is in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].
